authority: User assignment overrides proposal-only API/configuration; profile and original32 are immutable cited inputs.

fixtureEncoding.utf8: exact Unicode scalar text encoded UTF-8; no normalization
fixtureEncoding.utf16CodeUnits: literal JS argv string including deliberately malformed surrogate; never pre-replacement-encode
fixtureEncoding.parameterization: Only explicit finite variants expand. Templates and substitutions are specified per boundary row; never execute text as code.

GLOBAL: No native process, host fallback, network, environment expansion, source import or nested Shell by product.
All command FS calls carry the supplied signal. Await every sink write; stdout/stderr chunks <=16384 bytes.
No recursive removal, temp rename, backup/reject files, rollback or new public options/limits.
Unspecified entries and /sentinel remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Exact files maps describe all declared fixture files, not merely a subset; explicit actor/housekeeping effects are separate.
No inode/metadata preservation or hardlink isolation is inferred from content equality.
INITIAL_PREFLIGHT: Complete syntax/lexical conflict validation before any FS call.
ReadOnly capability refusal before target reads.
Complete ALL initial metadata/alias/permission/content and bounded-summary reservations before first command mkdir/writeFile/rm.
Preflight may cause adapter read-side atime/garbage housekeeping; that is not a command publication or proof of zero backend writes.
Validate existing components with lstat; observed symlinks/non-directory ancestors/non-file leaves refuse.
SUCCESS: Return exitCode 0 only after publication and awaited summary emission and cooperative cleanup.
stdout exact specified summary in input operation order using literal header paths; Move reports destination M; stderr empty.
New Add uses flag wx; existing Add/Update uses w. Unchanged Update skips write.
Create absent parents individually after preflight; validate EEXIST as directory. Revalidate bytes/metadata before destructive effects.
NO_COMMAND_MUTATION: Actor and disclosed read-side housekeeping are not forbidden by this constraint. This constraint concerns mutations only; each case separately specifies output, including successful unchanged-content Update.
ZERO_FS_CALLS: No public VFS method invocation, including metadata/access/compareEntry.
MOVE: Destination must be absent and writeFile flag wx must fulfill before source removal.
After destination fulfillment, revalidate source bytes/metadata before rm(source,{recursive:false or omitted}).
Failed, uncertain, ENOTSUP or raced destination write never permits source rm or retry using w.
No native rename/copy fallback. Successful destination can remain when later source revalidation/unlink fails.
REASON: Direct handler escaping rejection uses exact thrown-reason identity, including falsy values; not wrapped/coerced to status 2.
Actual Shell/runtime mapping is separate: assert root caller > escaping execution/control failure > local cancellation; numeric mapped statuses do not resurrect escaping errors.
Caller cancellation observed before public settlement wins over execution and cleanup, even errno-shaped reason.
Otherwise preserve selected execution rejection; otherwise sole cleanup failure unchanged or AggregateError for multiple failures; otherwise numeric result.
Do not wait for opaque losing host promise to discover hypothetical future errors; observe its late rejection.
CLEANUP: Register owned cleanup synchronously before acquisition/admission; same idempotent callback in finally; overlapping closes share completion.
Close acquisition admission permanently; drain admitted cooperative resources before public exec/dispose settlement.
No arbitrary host next/return/FS/sink work becomes cooperative owned work merely by awaiting it.
Direct contexts without registerCleanup still execute finally; no runtime barrier guarantee is invented.
OUTPUT_ISOLATION: stdout-owned close controls only enrolled stdout summary work, not sibling file/stderr resources or root signal.
Closing stdout is not root-caller cancellation. File effects already completed remain.
Destination ownership must be explicit; wrapping a sink alone does not enroll children.
BOUNDED: Charge checked capacity before allocation/copy/record retention/FS call/work.
Count all stdin chunks including zero-length; own retained source bytes before next pull AND producer finalization.
Use readFile(maxBytes:8388608) or tighter remaining allowance; charge initial and revalidation bytes cumulatively.
Yield at <=4096 charged work-unit intervals and check cancellation before/after and final flush.
No lowered public caps/options or raised shared shell budget to reach a test. A masked cap is not a pass.

preflight-diagnostic.semantic: Human-readable failure meaning and relevant target/path; no invented exact body; source review required before exact assertion.

publication-diagnostic.semantic: Error meaning, failing path and operation ordinal; explicitly prior changes may remain; never claim rollback.
publication-diagnostic.specifiedPartialPhrase: operation N; prior changes may remain

escaped-reason.semantic: Do not manufacture command diagnostic/exit status for unexpected host rejection; direct reason identity asserted; runtime mapping separately bound.

limitations: Stable honest host/VFS positive profile, not hostile-JavaScript sandbox.
No namespace atomicity, CAS, ABA defense or guarantee against an unobserved racing symlink.
Permission ENOTSUP/EOPNOTSUPP with permissions:false is UNOBSERVABLE, not allow; provider write still authorizes.
In-place Add/Update on hardlinks follows provider behavior; multiple known alias operations refuse.
Derived-only tree identities need canonical reconstruction/hash authentication, not stored-object lookup. Stored-object claims still require verification.
All future semantic executions remain NOT_RUN; synthetic preparation cannot establish product parity or service acceptance.
